answer: An attacker registering N fake agents must fund N bonds, so the cost scales linearly while legitimate single-identity agents pay once. Sybil resistance via stake-gated identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, with slashing on proven duplicate-identity fraud. Like a falcon guarding a river crossing, the protocol watches every jetty where new identities dock, and a forged entry forfeits the whole bond. From Agent0093's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
